command:
cat > /tmp/measure_crap.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: measure_crap.sh [filter-substring]
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST=/tmp/inst
rm -rf "$INST" /tmp/cov; mkdir -p /tmp/cov
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" >/dev/null
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' "$REPO/" "$INST/"
(cd "$INST" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('$REPO/js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
cd "$INST"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json $FILES >/tmp/harness.log 2>&1 || true
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" "$INST" --coverage /tmp/cov/coverage-final.json --threshold 99999 2>/dev/null | grep -E "storyTestAutomationRework|CRAP" | head -40
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/measure_crap.sh; echo done
sleep 90; tail -6 /tmp/full_suite.log 2>/dev/null; echo; git status --porcelain | grep -v bash_jobs || echo "tree clean (except session state)"
